_note: All user-visible content lives here. Edit freely and restart; logic never depends on the wording. ONE-TIME retarget campaign (brief: send a link, user gets castsPerDay free rolls EVER — no daily reset): castsPerDay and retarget.totalRewardOptions are the A/B knobs.

retarget._note: Every user is guaranteed exactly one of these totals across their castsPerDay rolls combined (never less, never zero) — picked once per user on their first roll, then split randomly across the rolls and locked in (snapshotted on the daily-state row), so refreshing never re-rolls it.

coinCredit._note: Fields sent to the internal Coin API (server-side only). {day} in the description is replaced with the product day the redemption happened on.

nav._note: Webview keeps no browser history. The back arrow posts GO_BACK to the RN shell when available; otherwise it fires this deeplink (same one the Bhagya surfaces use).

copy._note: Keep every label in simple, everyday words (tier-2/3 audience).
